name: line-conic-ring-spin
title: Rotating Gradient Ring
description: Một vòng tròn viền gradient hình nón xoay đều, như viền nút hay ánh sáng chờ.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Ring (outer r 50, 8 px band) filled with a conic gradient: accent -> yellow at 30 % -> transparent at 60 % -> accent; the gradient's start angle turns 0 -> 360 deg every 2000 ms linear, looping seamlessly. Params: radius (50 px) · width (8 px) · period (2 s) · colors. A conic gradient accent → yellow (30 %) → transparent (60 %) → accent whose start angle turns.
